// lint-expect: 1
// lint-as: internal/coach/store/gen/api_key_config.sql.go
// Same flip for the generated half: m1-10's queries use explicit column lists that never
// name is_default, so a `SELECT *` expansion reaching it is a real regression — exactly
// the breakage m1-08's contract migration would hit.

package gen

const getKey = `-- name: GetKey :one
SELECT id, account_id, provider, is_default, created_at FROM coach.api_key_config
WHERE account_id = $1
`
